_about: Public-domain William Rintoul (1797-1851), Church of Scotland minister at Maryport and then at York (Toronto) and Streetsville, Upper Canada, for the Word Hoard: Remarks on the Claims of Scotsmen Abroad (1826). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 111 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
